aboutHelp.onlyEnglishPlease: I (author of the project) don't speak a lot of languages, so please file your issues in English. Thanks!
aboutHelp.p1: Anori is a free and open source extension. Source code can be found on <0>GitHub</0>. If you would like to suggest a feature or report a bug, please create <1>new issue</1> in repository. If you just want to say thanks you can star that repo :).
aboutHelp.p2: If you would like to modify this extension, add your own plugin or widget, please refer to <0>readme</0> for more info.
aboutHelp.p3: Follow the author on <0>Twitter</0> and <1>support Ukraine</1>.

start.title: Welcome to Anori!
start.p1: Glad to see you! Let's take a quick tour.
start.p2: You're on your way to setup your ideal new tab. Anori start page consists of different widgets, like notes, bookmarks, todo lists, etc. You choose what to add and how to organize them.
start.p3: You can add your first widget by clicking on the pencil ('$t(editFolder)') in the dock at the bottom left. This will switch the page into editing mode. Here you can add new widgets and reposition or remove existing ones.
start.p4: To add a new widget, click on the '$t(addWidget)' button, or click on '$t(done)' to exit editing mode. Once you add your first widget, this onboarding will disappear. You can add a widget right now and explore the extension on your own, or, if you'd like to know a bit more about the features Anori has to offer, click '$t(next)'.

folders.title: Folders
folders.p1: By default all your widgets are being added to the '$t(home)' folder. However, you can also organize your widgets in different folders. For example, you could have different folders for work and personal widgets. Or you could have a separate folder for each individual project.
folders.p2: To manage folders, click on a gears icon in the bottom left corner. This will open settings, where you can customize Anori to your liking. Click on '$t(settings.folders.title)' there to open folders manager.

customization.title: Customization
customization.p1: While Anori lets you compose your own start page from widgets, it can be customized even more.
customization.p2: You can change the title of a new tab, change the color scheme along with background image and upload your custom icons to use in widgets (in addition to 10,000+ built-in icons).
customization.p3: And this isn't even half of the options. You might want to check out settings to see them all.

presets.title: New start
presets.p1: That's all. Now you have an express bachelor's degree in Anori and are prepared to create your own start page. Add your first widget and start building the ultimate setup.
presets.p2: Tired of choices? It's okay. You don't need to nail down your perfect page on the first try. You don't even need to start from a blank canvas. We have a productive setup prepared for you.
presets.p3: It might not be tailored for all your needs, but you can use it as a base to make your own setup you'll love.
presets.cta: 🚀 Just give me a productive setup
